author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ನಂಬದಿರು ಅತಿವಿನಯ ತೋರುವರ
ಜತೆನಡೆದೆ ನಿನ ತಪ್ಪು ದಾರಿಗೆಳೆಯುವರು
ಮಿತಿಯಿರಲಿ ನಂಬಿಕೆಗೆ ಪರಿಕಿಸುತ ಸಾಗುತಿರು
ಜತನದಿಂದೆಚ್ಚರಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t trust too much those who show excessive humility;
walking with you, they may drag you onto the wrong path;
let there be a limit to trust; keep testing as you go;
stay carefully alert, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Overdone humility can hide ulterior motives. Trust, but within limits, and keep testing it as you go.
